info.name: 12 - Coach Assignment
info.description: Endpoints to assign coaches to members and query coach-member assignments per gym.

request.description:
Fetches all members assigned to a specific coach within a gym.

### Request Fields (`GetAssignedMemberForCoachPagedReq`)

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `coachId` | `int` | Yes | Gym person ID of the coach (staff) |
| `gymId` | `int` | Yes | Target gym ID |
| `pageNumber` | `int` | No | Defaults to 1 |
| `pageSize` | `int` | No | Defaults to 10, max 50 |
| `orderBy` | `string` | No | Defaults to `Id` |
| `orderDirection` | `string` | No | `asc` or `desc` |

Returns `Result<PaginatedRes<CoachAssignmentRDTO>>`.

### Authorization

Requires gym role `Owner`, `Manager`, or `Coach`. SuperAdmin bypasses all gym checks.

Fetches all coaches assigned to a specific member within a gym.

### Request Fields (`GetAssignCoachForMemberPagedReq`)

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `memberId` | `int` | Yes | Gym person ID of the member |
| `gymId` | `int` | Yes | Target gym ID |
| `pageNumber` | `int` | No | Defaults to 1 |
| `pageSize` | `int` | No | Defaults to 10, max 50 |
| `orderBy` | `string` | No | Defaults to `Id` |
| `orderDirection` | `string` | No | `asc` or `desc` |

Returns `Result<PaginatedRes<CoachAssignmentRDTO>>`.

### Authorization

Requires gym role `Owner`, `Manager`, `Coach`, or `Member`. SuperAdmin bypasses all gym checks.

Fetches all coach-member assignments in the current gym with dynamic sorting and filtering.

---

### Available Domain Attributes & Filter Reference

| Attribute Name | Data Type | Filter Support | Description / Allowed Values |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `Id` | `int` | Exact | Unique Identifier |
| `GymId` | `int` | Exact | Associated Gym ID |
| `MemberId` | `int` | Exact | Assigned member gym person ID |
| `CoachStaffId` | `int` | Exact | Coach (staff) gym person ID |
| `AssignedById` | `int` | Exact | Gym person ID who created the assignment |
| `AssignedAt` | `DateTime` | Between | ISO assignment timestamp |
| `EndedAt` | `DateTime?` | - | ISO end timestamp (nullable) |

---

### Filter Usage Guide (For Request Body)

- **Exact Filters (`exactFilters`):** Pass attribute name with array of string/enum values. Example: `"exactFilters": { "CoachStaffId": ["2"] }`
- **Between Filters (`betweenFilters`):** Pass attribute name with `min` and `max`. Example: `"betweenFilters": { "AssignedAt": { "min": "2026-01-01", "max": "2026-12-31" } }`

---

### Authorization

Requires gym role `Owner` or `Manager`. SuperAdmin bypasses all gym checks.

Assigns a coach (staff member) to a member. `gymId` and `assignedBy` are resolved from the authenticated user.

### Request Fields (`CoachAssignmentCDTO`)

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `memberId` | `int` | Yes | Gym person ID of the member |
| `coachStaffId` | `int` | Yes | Gym person ID of the coach (must not be a `Member`) |

### Behavior

- Fails with `404` if the member does not exist.
- Fails with `404` if the coach does not exist or is a `Member` type.

Returns `201 Created` with `Result<CoachAssignmentRDTO>`.

### Authorization

Requires `[Authorize]` (any authenticated user). Rate-limited via `UserRateLimiter`.
